faq.q: What is a titanium rf grounding spring finger?
faq.a: A titanium rf grounding spring finger is a precision-machined chamber shield component used in rf grounding spring contact finger (nitinol). Manufactured from Grade 2 CP-Ti (Bead Blasted) for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium rf grounding spring finger?
faq.a: Titanium RF Grounding Spring Finger is designed for rf grounding spring contact finger (nitinol). The Grade 2 CP-Ti (Bead Blasted) grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium rf grounding spring finger manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium RF Grounding Spring Finger is manufactured using Precision CNC turning. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium rf grounding spring finger?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
